verdict.rationale: Omarchy documents a system-wide theme switcher: nineteen bundled themes, a dedicated hotkey selector, and themes that restyle the terminal, bar, notifications and wallpaper. That makes switching the whole desktop's look plausible, but no document explicitly names a dark mode or dark theme, and nothing mentions a night light or blue-light filter. missing for 10: an explicit dark mode or dark-theme toggle, any night light/blue-light filter feature, hands-on corroboration.
